Then it dips and falls down.
The kite will not fly. It has a big hole in it.
"My kite broke!" says Eve. Eve takes the kite to her mom. "Can we fix it?"
Mom gets some white tape. "Let's use this," Mom says. She sticks the tape on.
"Now let's try to fly it," Eve says. Eve runs and the kite rises back up!
